entries.nextAction: node-opcua 2.187.12's OPCUAServer is no discovery server: it answers RegisterServer, RegisterServer2 and FindServersOnNetwork with BadServiceUnsupported (pinned by TestNodeOpcuaServer_DiscoveryServerUnsupported). node-opcua's LDS is the separate OPCUADiscoveryServer without the fixture address space, so the adapter refuses --lds / --mdns-name / --mdns-capability with exit 2

node-opcua 2.187.12's OPCUAServer is no discovery server: it answers RegisterServer, RegisterServer2 and FindServersOnNetwork with BadServiceUnsupported (pinned by TestNodeOpcuaServer_DiscoveryServerUnsupported). node-opcua's LDS is the separate OPCUADiscoveryServer without the fixture address space, so the adapter refuses --lds / --mdns-name / --mdns-capability with exit 2
node-opcua soft-accepts EncodingMask timestamp Writes (StatusGood); claim requires BadWriteNotSupported

node-opcua 2.187.12 revises the queue size of an event monitored item to at least 100 (minimumEventQueueSize, monitored_item.js), so a queue of 2 is never granted and the fixture's event rate (one every 2 s) cannot fill it in a test; the test skips when the revised size is not 2. Needs a fixture that bursts more than 100 events
